question: The human papilloma virus (HPV):

options.opa: It has a plasma membrane and a genome composed of RNA.
options.opb: His serotypes 16 and 18 are associated with cervical cancer.
options.opc: Blood transfusion is one of its main routes of transmission.
options.opd: Its treatment includes inhibitors of viral reverse transcriptase.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: HPV -> DNA virus -> not composed of RNA -> 95% CHAIN: HPV -> serotypes 16 and 18 -> associated with cervical cancer -> 98% CHAIN: HPV -> transmission mainly through sexual contact -> not blood transfusion -> 90% CHAIN: HPV treatment -> does not include inhibitors of viral reverse transcriptase -> 95%
enhanced_information: HPV is a DNA virus, not composed of RNA. Serotypes 16 and 18 are indeed associated with cervical cancer. HPV is mainly transmitted through sexual contact, not blood transfusion. Treatment for HPV does not include inhibitors of viral reverse transcriptase. Evidence supports the fact that HPV belongs to DNA viruses.
